acceptanceCriteria: A check whose output contains a secret-shaped token and a FAIL line retains the FAIL line with the token redacted, covered by a test.
The verify result names the failing test when one is present.
body:
Filed 2026-10-08 by the orchestrator from batch C (branch claude/batch-c-2026-10-07, base 0c94c66c).

In batch C stage 3, the tests-tasks lifecycle check failed once (rc=1) and corvint secret-screened its log (secretScreened:true); both retained files held only log-secret-screened, so the failing test could not be identified. A direct rerun passed, so the failure was classified as a load flake without evidence. Also observed in the same run: too-many-obligations refused a plan of 252 obligations under the 256 cap (see V1-1013). Expected: screening redacts the secret-shaped spans but keeps the remaining failure lines (test names, FAIL lines), or retains a redacted excerpt.
title: dogfood verify: secret-screened check log discards the test failure output
